as_of_recipe: Load /why/{TICKER}.json for history_url and history_manifest_url. Use ONLY the COMPLETE history file whose build_id, SHA-256, byte count and object count match the manifest. Filter available_as_of <= D after normalizing timestamps to UTC; a date-only D means 23:59:59.999999 UTC. Do not substitute filing_date or generated. A capped PREVIEW returns INCOMPLETE unless returned equals total_available; it cannot establish zero historical evidence. D outside corpus_start/corpus_end returns OUT_OF_RANGE. Classification at D uses the label_history entry with the maximum eligible date, not list order. Before that ribbon, use yuclaw replay TICKER --date D on a research backend.

component_anatomy.formula: sum(weight * confidence * score) / sum(weight * confidence), excluding not_implemented components
component_anatomy.note: Confidence is a model input, not a calibrated probability. Current configuration weights do not establish historical weights. C4 is disclosed as frozen; no past score is changed.
